evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We release ACI-Defect, a perturbation benchmark; clinician-reviewed instance-level labels showing quality gaps in the ACI-bench gold standard (32 of 40 notes contain hallucinations; 40 of 40 omit discussed facts); and grounding-judge verdicts.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The criteria that fail enforceability are disproportionately the ones clinicians raise most often, because high-frequency complaints are stated as several questions glued together.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating the quality of AI-generated clinical notes is hard: standard metrics like ROUGE measure lexical similarity to reference notes, while expert checklists encode what committees believe matters.
